name: How long does it typically take to build a custom home in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How long does it typically take to build a custom home in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for building a custom home in Los Angeles can vary significantly, generally ranging from 12 to 24 months from initial design to move-in. This duration depends on several factors, including the home's size and complexity, site conditions, the permitting process, and material availability. Design and architectural planning typically take 3-6 months, while construction can last 9-18 months. We work to provide a detailed project schedule early in the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Building a custom home in Los Angeles typically takes 12 to 24 months, depending on factors like size, complexity, and permitting.
